description: integrations.sh is a registry of developer and agent integration surfaces across many services, including APIs, GraphQL endpoints, MCP servers, and CLIs. It also provides detection and discovery tools for finding what integration surfaces a domain exposes.
summary: integrations.sh exposes three documented developer surfaces: a REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api`, a streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`, and an npm-distributed `integrations` CLI; the registry states no credentials are required for these documented surfaces.
